stories.title: Russia 'comfortable' with NATO-like security guarantees for Ukraine, Trump envoy says
stories.summary: U.S. envoy Jared Kushner said in Berlin that Russia is 'comfortable' with NATO-like security guarantees for Ukraine as part of a deal to end the war, hours after Trump's first-ever trilateral talks with Putin in Shenzhen. The remarks came as U.S. envoys joined a Berlin meeting with Ukraine's Zelenskyy and more than 40 European leaders.

stories.title: Trump, Xi and Putin hold unprecedented Shenzhen summit, issue 'peace declaration' but achieve little
stories.summary: The first three-way meeting of the U.S., Chinese and Russian leaders ended after about 90 minutes with a symbolic declaration on UN reform, oil supplies and nuclear-risk dialogue, but no breakthroughs on Ukraine or Iran. Putin ruled out direct talks with Kyiv, and Trump left without taking reporters' questions.

stories.title: Alibaba and Tencent brace for AI hits after US tightens Nvidia chip access
stories.summary: Chinese tech giants are warning that new U.S. rules restricting remote access to advanced chips will disrupt AI model training, with Tencent's president saying the curbs 'set everyone back in China.' A U.S. think tank estimated overseas data centers could have supplied roughly a third of China's AI compute by 2027.

stories.title: Meta's Muse AI agent mixed up conversations and could be exposing private data, report says
stories.summary: Internal Meta posts reviewed by Reuters show employees flagged Muse surfacing other people's bank balances and reading encrypted Signal messages via Android push notifications, alongside possible cross-account context leaks. Meta calls the incidents isolated and says many were AI 'hallucinations.'

stories.title: Anthropic jumps 34% in Nasdaq debut after record $81B IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic opened trading at $111.50, 34% above its $83 IPO price, valuing the Claude maker near $2 trillion after the biggest IPO on record, topping SpaceX. Shares slipped back under $100 by afternoon as the Nasdaq fell more than 1.5%.

stories.title: UK tribunal forces Home Office to acknowledge secret Apple encryption order
stories.summary: An Investigatory Powers Tribunal ruled the UK government must confirm it served Apple a secret 'technical capability notice' demanding access to encrypted data, calling the secrecy claim 'fanciful.' Apple's challenge to the order can now largely proceed in open court.

stories.title: TSMC and Samsung suspend some chip shipments to China under new US curbs
stories.summary: The world's two biggest foundries have halted some China shipments while applying for U.S. export licenses, after new rules took effect Thursday closing a loophole Chinese chip designers used to get advanced chips made. Chinese customers are largely restricted to older 28/40nm processes, and some smartphone chip orders are paused too.

stories.title: Browns build camaraderie by reading more than just the playbook
stories.summary: A Fox 8 feature on how the Browns are building team chemistry through shared reading beyond the playbook during their bye week. Cleveland returns to action Nov. 29 against the Raiders on Sunday Night Football.

stories.title: Browns re-sign rookie TE Carsen Ryan to the practice squad
stories.summary: Cleveland signed the seventh-round pick out of BYU back to the practice squad Thursday, two days after waiving him to open a roster spot. Ryan has appeared in nine games this season, almost entirely on special teams.

stories.title: No. 16 Ohio State 'getting back to basics' with playoff hopes revived before Nebraska
stories.summary: The Buckeyes (7-3, 5-2 Big Ten) rose six spots to No. 14 in the College Football Playoff rankings and suddenly have a live at-large path if they win at Nebraska and vs Michigan and get some upsets. Freshman QB Luke Fahey stays under center with Julian Sayin (elbow) out again.

stories.title: Ohio State vs. Nebraska predictions: Are the Buckeyes on upset alert?
stories.summary: Dispatch writers pick Saturday's game in Lincoln, where 7-3 Ohio State is only a narrow favorite despite its rankings jump. A loss would end the Buckeyes' Big Ten title and playoff hopes.

stories.title: Liam Lawson 'grateful' Helmut Marko no longer calls the shots at Red Bull
stories.summary: The Racing Bulls driver said he is relieved the former Red Bull adviser no longer makes final driver decisions, after Marko opposed keeping him for 2027. Lawson sits on 89 points this season, best of the rest behind F1's big four teams.

stories.title: Haas confirms Bearman will stay for 2027 alongside Camara
stories.summary: Haas ended speculation over Oliver Bearman's future by confirming he remains for 2027, paired with rookie Rafael Camara. It resolves a week in which Bearman admitted the unsigned contract had become a mental burden.

stories.title: Antonelli takes five-place Vegas grid penalty as Piastri drops ten
stories.summary: World champion Kimi Antonelli will lose five grid places in Las Vegas after Mercedes fitted a sixth engine to his car, joining Oscar Piastri, who already faces a ten-place drop. Both penalties still need formal FIA confirmation ahead of Saturday's grid.

stories.title: Hamilton confirms work underway on F1 movie sequel
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton told a Las Vegas fan forum that a sequel to 'F1: The Movie' is in development, with the seven-time champion again producing. He also recounted flying an F-16 at 9.5G and joked he told Tom Cruise he's 'ready for Top Gun 3.'

stories.title: Tarkov Season 2 'UNTAR Control' modifiers revealed by Nikita Buyanov
stories.summary: Battlestate's studio head posted the full modifier list for December's Season 2: UN troops hostile to all Scavs, an insurance ban, restricted extracts and supply shortages, plus pickable quirks like phantom sounds and a 15% chance to drop magazines on reload. The flea market unlocks only after a global objective is completed.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov patch 1.3.5.0 to overhaul raid reconnection and loading
stories.summary: Battlestate's developer diary details patch 1.3.5.0's technical work: a redesigned resource-loading architecture, broader performance improvements, and a reconnect flow that drops players straight back into an interrupted raid without a main-menu detour. Stash and trading screens also get improved network-error handling.

stories.title: Wildlights returns to the Columbus Zoo for its 38th year
stories.summary: The Columbus Zoo's Wildlights opens Friday and runs through Jan. 3, adding new Starlight Safari and LEGO Bricktopia attractions to millions of LED lights, with train and carousel rides now included with admission. Zoo members get a first look at tonight's member night.

stories.title: Wanderlights returns with 500,000 lights and free admission downtown
stories.summary: The free downtown light display links Columbus Commons, Bicentennial Park and the Lazarus Building with more than half a million lights from Friday through Feb. 14. December 'Wander Nights' add a holiday market, carousel rides and a free covered trolley.
